input.answer: Canada's New Housing Price Index (Total, house and land; 201612=100) fell 2.0% from September 2025 to September 2026. The index was 122.7 in September 2025 and 120.2 in September 2026. The calculation is (120.2 − 122.7) / 122.7 × 100 = −2.5 / 122.7 × 100 ≈ −2.0%. I read "house and land" as the table's "Total (house and land)" series.
